description: This file defines the interface for RTL8367C switch API related to IEEE 802.1X network security features, including enums and function prototypes for configuring port behaviors, guest VLANs, and trap priorities.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xPBEnConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration for port-based 802.1X enablement on a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xPBEnConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration for port-based 802.1X enablement on a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xPBAuthConfig
methods.description: Configures the 802.1X authentication behavior for a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xPBAuthConfig
methods.description: Gets the 802.1X authentication configuration for a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xPBOpdirConfig
methods.description: Sets the operation direction configuration for port-based 802.1X.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xPBOpdirConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the operation direction configuration for port-based 802.1X.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xMBEnConfig
methods.description: Enables or disables MAC-based 802.1X on a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xMBEnConfig
methods.description: Retrieves MAC-based 802.1X enablement status for a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xMBOpdirConfig
methods.description: Sets the operation direction for MAC-based 802.1X.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xMBOpdirConfig
methods.description: Gets the operation direction for MAC-based 802.1X.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xProcConfig
methods.description: Configures processing options for a port related to 802.1X.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xProcConfig
methods.description: Retrieves processing configuration for a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xGuestVidx
methods.description: Sets the guest VLAN index for 802.1X.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xGuestVidx
methods.description: Gets the current guest VLAN index for 802.1X.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xGVOpdir
methods.description: Enables or disables guest VLAN operation direction.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xGVOpdir
methods.description: Checks whether guest VLAN operation direction is enabled.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xTrapPriority
methods.description: Sets the trap priority for 802.1X related traps.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xTrapPriority
methods.description: Retrieves the current trap priority setting.
